Step-5-Preview-NVFP4 · 4× GB200 · TP=4. Baseline: CUTLASS NVFP4 / Triton BF16 MoE; after: TRTLLM-Gen MoE.

| Accuracy | Before | After | Δ |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| GSM8K (1,319 questions, 5-shot, greedy, max 512 output tokens) | 91.96% (1213/1319) | 93.18% (1229/1319) | +1.21 pp |

Performance: median of 3 runs after warmup; decode CUDA graphs enabled.

| Workload (input/output tokens) | Batch | Before | After | Speedup |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Decode (128/128), output tok/s | 1 | 62.71 | 122.37 | 1.95× |
| Decode (128/128), output tok/s | 8 | 392.62 | 768.39 | 1.96× |
| Decode (128/128), output tok/s | 32 | 1446.23 | 2207.34 | 1.53× |
| Prefill (1024/1), latency ms | 1 | 214.40 | 166.65 | 1.29× |
| Prefill (1024/1), latency ms | 8 | 843.74 | 494.87 | 1.70× |
| Prefill (1024/1), latency ms | 32 | 2033.27 | 1605.27 | 1.27× |
